sources.finding: Incompatible open sharing modes fail with ERROR_SHARING_VIOLATION. The options remain in force until the conflicting handle closes. A bounded retry is tested separately from frame validation.

Desktop Duplication provides a DXGI surface with the output desktop image in BGRA8 format. The observer reads two controlled locations and adds GPU copy work. This is not a camera or a zero-GPU claim.
DO_NOT_WAIT returns DXGI_ERROR_WAS_STILL_DRAWING when the GPU has not completed the resource. The diagnostic retries this status within two seconds; other errors remain fatal.

KEYEVENTF_UNICODE produces VK_PACKET key events. TranslateMessage posts the character message. The lab must verify the key-to-character path rather than assume arbitrary metadata survives translation.

Software cursor is enabled by default when a mode is committed. The current IDD does not enable a hardware cursor. Cursor presentation and ordinary physical-pointer behavior still require local qualification.
